name: Academic Corpus Consolidation
description: Turn identifiers (DOI / PMID / arXiv id) or a topic query into canonical metadata, a LEGAL access-status table, span-cited extractions and a T1-T4 evidence-graded shortlist. The distinguishing machine is the access gate: a paper whose PDF is not open-access is reported metadata-only and may never be paraphrased from its abstract as though it had been read, and the paywall-circumvention route is DENIED in tool_policy rather than merely discouraged. Because identifiers are stable this is the one research blueprint in the set that is genuinely replayable - with verify=schema-equal, because access_status is time-varying.

input_mode.description: Which resolve path runs; the other is skipped by its `when`

identifiers.description: DOIs / PMIDs / arXiv ids when input_mode is identifiers

topic_query.description: Free-text query when input_mode is topic

evidence_scheme.description: t1t4 = human / animal / in-vitro / mechanistic tiering

expand_citation_graph.description: Optional S1b: one hop, to catch the paper everyone cites and nobody listed

resolver.description: Resolves each identifier to canonical metadata; a miss is returned in `unresolved` with the failing probe, never a plausible-looking title

access-classifier.description: Decides open-access vs paywalled per paper and owns the legal gate; has VETO over any downstream read

span-reader.description: Extracts findings only as quoted spans with a page location; never summarises a paper it could not open

evidence-grader.description: Assigns T1-T4 and records that the tier is a model judgement over the stated study design, not a measurement

shortlist-synthesiser.description: Ranks and summarises; may cite only span-backed findings and must carry the metadata-only rows through visibly

stages.title: Resolve supplied identifiers to canonical metadata

work_unit.title: Resolve every supplied identifier, or return it as unresolved with the failing probe
work_unit.question_or_target: For each supplied identifier, fetch canonical metadata from a registry. An identifier with no registry hit is returned under `unresolved` with the probe that missed - never as a fabricated title.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row carries the registry queried and its raw response id; each unresolved row carries the probe and the miss
tests_required: a syntactically valid but non-existent DOI must land in `unresolved`; a real DOI in the same batch must resolve (both-states in one run)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the access classifier refuses to classify any row lacking a registry response id
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0301 emitted only when every supplied identifier appears exactly once, either resolved with a registry id or unresolved with a probe; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0301 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 3 attempts per identifier; a third miss is recorded unresolved rather than retried further

stages.title: Resolve a topic query to a candidate paper set

work_unit.title: Search the scholarly indexes for the topic and cap the candidate set
work_unit.question_or_target: Search the scholarly indexes for the topic query and emit at most max_papers candidates, each already carrying a canonical identifier so the rest of the pipeline is identifier-anchored.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the sampling frame records every index queried, the query string, the returned count and the cap that was applied
tests_required: a topic with more hits than max_papers must record the truncation as a declared cap, never present the floor as the total
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer checks the frame is not silently biased to one index
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0302 emitted only when the frame exists, parses, names every index queried, and every candidate carries a canonical identifier; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0302 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts per index

stages.title: No resolved paper without a registry hit
Legal access classification per paper (the veto stage)

work_unit.title: Classify each paper open-access or paywalled and record the licence evidence
work_unit.question_or_target: For every resolved paper decide OPEN-ACCESS (with the OA PDF URL and its licence) or PAYWALLED. A PAYWALLED paper is marked metadata-only and its row forbids any downstream read.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row carries the licence string, the OA URL when open, and the measurement date - access status is time-varying and must be dated
tests_required: a set with a known-paywalled paper must yield exactly that many metadata-only rows
both-states: a known-OA paper in the same set must be classified open with its licence named
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the span reader treats this table as authoritative and cannot open a paper it marks metadata-only
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0303 emitted only when every paper has an access row carrying a licence or an explicit paywalled marker plus a measurement date; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0303 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; an indeterminate status resolves to PAYWALLED (adverse inference on a blank required field)

stages.title: Read only the open-access PDFs, as quoted spans

body.title: Extract span-cited findings from one open-access paper

work_unit.title: Extract each finding as a quoted span with a page location
work_unit.question_or_target: Open the OA PDF and extract findings ONLY as quoted spans with a page location. If the access table marks this paper metadata-only, emit nothing and record the refusal.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every finding carries cited_text plus a page location; a finding without a span is dropped with that reason recorded
tests_required: a metadata-only paper must produce a recorded refusal and zero findings - never an abstract-derived summary
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the evidence grader may grade only span-backed findings and must reject a finding with no page location
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0304 emitted only when the span file exists, parses, and every finding carries cited_text and a page location; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0304 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed PDF opens, mark the paper unreadable rather than paraphrasing the abstract

stages.title: Assign T1-T4 evidence tiers over the stated study design

work_unit.title: Grade each paper T1-T4 from its stated design and record the judgement disclaimer
work_unit.question_or_target: Assign an evidence tier per paper from the design stated in its own quoted spans (T1 human trial, T2 human observational, T3 animal, T4 in-vitro or mechanistic), citing the span that establishes the design.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each tier cites the span that states the design; the artifact records in-band that tiering is judgement over a stated design, not a measurement
tests_required: a paper whose spans never state a design must be tiered UNKNOWN, not guessed into T4
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer re-grades three papers blind to the first grade and any disagreement is recorded, not averaged away
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0305 emitted only when every span-backed paper has a tier or an explicit UNKNOWN plus the citing span; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0305 <failure-class> <reason>

work_unit.title: Expand one citation hop and keep only papers above the tier floor
work_unit.question_or_target: Walk one hop of the citation graph from the highest-tier papers and keep only new papers that would sit at or above the current tier floor; the expansion re-enters the access gate like any other paper.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each expanded paper names the paper it was reached from and the hop direction (cites / cited-by)
tests_required: an expansion that adds no paper above the tier floor must record an empty result with that reason, not an empty file
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the access classifier re-runs over every expanded paper; expansion does not bypass the legal gate
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0306 emitted only when the expansion exists, parses, and every row names its parent paper and hop direction; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0306 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: No paraphrase of a paywalled paper; no claim without a span; no circumvention call
Rank and summarise, carrying the metadata-only rows through visibly

work_unit.title: Emit the ranked shortlist plus the access summary and the unresolved set
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the ranked shortlist: one line per paper with its tier, its one-line span-backed finding, and its access status. Metadata-only and unresolved rows stay visible in the output.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every ranked line cites the span behind its finding; the access summary states the open / paywalled / unresolved counts numerically
tests_required: the sum of open + paywalled + unresolved rows must equal the input identifier count exactly - a dropped paper is a defect, not a rounding
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one adversarial reviewer in a fresh context checks no metadata-only paper has acquired a finding
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0307 emitted only when the shortlist exists, parses, reconciles its counts against the input set, and shows every metadata-only row; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0307 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failures emit the partial shortlist plus the blocking reason

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/research/bp-res-03/**; no paywall circumvention route is reachable

contraindications: NOT for a general web question - it is identifier-anchored by construction
NOT for grey literature or vendor whitepapers: no DOI means the tiering collapses
NEVER route through a paywall-circumvention proxy - that route is in tool_policy.deny, not merely discouraged
x_extensions.replay_note: the only genuinely replayable research blueprint of the twelve, because DOIs are stable. verify is schema-equal rather than hash-equal on purpose: access_status is time-varying, so a byte-equal replay would fail for a legitimate reason.
unverified: UNVERIFIED at scale; settling experiment = a 30-DOI run auditing every access_status against the publisher page and reporting the disagreement count.

worked_example.name: ten-DOI set with three known paywalled papers
acceptance: exactly as many metadata-only rows as there are paywalled papers
a fabricated DOI appears under unresolved with the failing probe
open + paywalled + unresolved == the supplied identifier count

stopping_rule_controls.why: the run may not stop while any paper still lacks a verdict
a barren expansion stops the walk only after enough papers have been graded to say so
